notes.title: New "Lost Sequel" Content + Game Updates
notes.content:
Happy Holidays all, hope everyone is having a fantastic time and that their wallets aren't hit too badly with these sales!

Hopefully this new patch will give some festive cheer with SIX brand new levels all bundled up in what I call the "Lost Sequel". All brand new levels, each with new fiendish gimmicks, graphics, enemies and bosses! Also included is a brand new bullet type called "ghost", a homing shot that will make mince meat out of those evil demons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611379/be6b4b5ae3fcfd2448b5cdd93210fa3dc196aae4.gif

Also with this update, I've included a few tweaks and additions to hopefully make the game a little more smooth and fun to play. These include;

 A new "unlimited lives" mode that can be toggled on/off in the option.
 While jumping and whipping, you will now move at full speed.
 When ran out of bullets, you will automatically switch to the whip.
 Hopefully fixed some bugs regarding getting stuck in terrain or general glitchiness.
 Removed "slowdown" option (as truth be told, no one really wants that do they?!)
 General polish on some graphical problems.


With that, I hope you enjoy these new levels, until the next game, take care!
